dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: What's the problem with your phone?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌts ðə ˈprɑːbləm wɪð jʊr ˈfoʊn?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: When I opened my email app this morning, it closed.
dialogue.reading: wɛn aɪ ˈoʊpənd maɪ ˈiːmeɪl ˌæp ðɪs ˈmɔːrnɪŋ, ɪt ˈkloʊzd.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Did you update the app yesterday?
dialogue.reading: dɪd juː ˌʌpˈdeɪt ði ˈæp ˈjɛstərdeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. And when I updated it, my phone stopped working for an hour.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ənd wɛn aɪ ˌʌpˈdeɪtɪd ɪt, maɪ ˈfoʊn ˈstɑːpt ˈwɜːrkɪŋ fər ən ˈaʊər.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Did you restart your phone after that?
dialogue.reading: dɪd juː ˌriːˈstɑːrt jʊr ˈfoʊn ˈæftər ˈðæt?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: OK. Let's delete the app and download it again. Then restart your phone.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ˈlɛts dɪˈliːt ði ˈæp ənd ˌdaʊnˈloʊd ɪt əˈɡɛn. ˈðɛn ˌriːˈstɑːrt jʊr ˈfoʊn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It works now! Thank you so much!
dialogue.reading: ɪt ˈwɜːrks ˈnaʊ! ˈθæŋk juː ˈsoʊ ˈmʌtʃ!
